<solar/>Solar Kills have a chance of granting 1 stack of Firewalker. [1-3 Kills, average of 2]
Becoming <stasis/>Frozen grants 1 stack of Firewalker.
Max of 4 Stacks.

Firewalker increases Weapon Damage depending on Stacks and lasts 10 seconds.
<pve 1x = 20% | 2x = 25% | 3x = 35% | 4x = 40% />
<pvp 1x = 15% | 2x = 25% | 3x = 20% | 4x = 35% />
(Yes, 3x is 20% in PVP, it's not a typo)

Slow Stacks and Duration are halved.
Receive no damage from Stasis Breakout.
Stasis Breakout also creates a burst of Solar Energy with a 9m radius, dealing 105 damage.
